balance_storage.description: Fix the quantity of carrier stored in a `storage` technology at the end of each timestep based on the net flow of carrier charged and discharged and the quantity of carrier stored at the start of the timestep.

storage_previous_step.where:
(
  (timesteps==get_val_at_index(timesteps=0) AND cyclic_storage==True)
  OR NOT timesteps==get_val_at_index(timesteps=0)
) AND NOT cluster_first_timestep==True
cluster_first_timestep==True AND NOT (timesteps==get_val_at_index(timesteps=0) AND NOT cyclic_storage==True)

balance_storage.where: (include_storage==true or base_tech==storage) AND NOT (base_tech==supply OR base_tech==demand)

flow_in_inc_eff.description: Inflows after taking efficiency losses into account.
flow_in_inc_eff.title: Carrier inflow including losses

flow_out_inc_eff.description: Outflows after taking efficiency losses into account.
flow_out_inc_eff.title: Carrier outflow including losses

base_tech.description: Should be the name of one of the abstract base classes, from which some initial parameter defaults will be derived and with which certain base math will be triggered.
base_tech.title: Abstract base technology name.

cluster_first_timestep.description: If true, the timestep is the first in the given clustered day.
cluster_first_timestep.title: Cluster first timestep.

cyclic_storage.description: If true, link storage levels in the last model timestep with the first model timestep. `inter_cluster_storage` custom math must be included if using time clustering and setting this to `true`.
cyclic_storage.title: Cyclic storage switch.

include_storage.description: When true, math will be triggered to allow discontinuous carrier inflow and outflows across timesteps.
include_storage.title: Storage method switch.

lookup_cluster_last_timestep.description: The last timestep of each cluster.

storage_initial.description: Set stored flow in device at the first timestep, as a fraction of total storage capacity.
storage_initial.title: Initial storage level.

storage_loss.description: Rate of storage loss per hour, used to calculate lost stored flow as `(1 - storage_loss)^hours_per_timestep`.
storage_loss.title: Storage loss rate

storage.description: The carrier stored by a `storage` technology in each timestep.
storage.title: Stored carrier

storage_cap.description: The upper limit on a carrier that can be stored by a technology in any timestep.
storage_cap.title: Stored carrier capacity
